ablations: no trained state must return RequiresSecondPass=true and no selected skills
candidate-order permutation must keep selected_skill stable
exact prompt/source id/path/filename/pair id removed must not change a correct decision
prompt_context-only ablation must not over-select broad generic skills on P24 near-miss rows
final-selection-only ablation must select the exact expected skill on each repaired row
wrong rejected-skill ablation must fail when only generic implementation/test/plan signals are present
lifecycle: fresh-load probe: export candidate checkpoint, import into a new SkillSelectionMachine, rerun P24/P26 eval without in-memory training leftovers
continue-training probe: load existing candidate checkpoint first, append bounded repair rows, prove old accepted rows are not forgotten
export/import manifest: manifest, checkpoint, locator, source manifest and training-data card must reference exact hashes and no semantic_quality_claimed until all gates pass
runtime_api_dashboard_evidence: runtime API evidence must call SkillSelectionMachine.DecideFromTrainedState through the same boundary used in P25
dashboard/API row may show visible selected skill, rejected skills, evidence features, and no-overclaim flags, but dashboard evidence is not semantic-quality proof by itself

before any readiness claim, report must include source-disjoint runtime pass, ablation pass, fresh-load pass, continue-training pass, export/import pass, and unchanged common model until promotion is separately authorized
eval_plan.no_candidate_position_or_order_leakage: Every eval row must be rerun with at least two candidate order permutations; selected_skill must remain the same and evidence must show candidate-position scaffold was not final authority.
